positive.prompt: Package these approved requirements, examples, use case, design decisions, and repository facts into one bounded coding-agent brief
Select the smallest ready vertical behavior slice and trace every expectation to its approved source revision
Refresh this implementation brief after a requirement revision and expose any stale source or stop condition

negative.prompt: Synthesize these stakeholder notes into candidate requirements and record who validated or approved each one
Implement the approved behavior test-first, demonstrate the check detects the gap, and run focused regression tests

evals.prompt: Review the approved requirements, analysis, design input, and current repository. Create briefs/reconciliation-match.md for the smallest ready vertical behavior slice. Trace every in-scope expectation to its exact source revision and status, keep repository facts distinct, and package existing verification commands without claiming to run them. Queue persistence depends on an unresolved retention decision: exclude it and make it a coding-agent stop condition. Do not modify code or invent behavior, acceptance criteria, architecture, or retention values.
evals.expected_output: A ready implementation slice brief for opaque-reference matching, with exact source and repository baselines, traceable approved behavior, existing design inputs, verification handoff, exclusions, and stop conditions.
expectations: The slice delivers the approved matching outcome without queue persistence
Every in-scope expectation traces to an approved source revision and authority
Repository facts and commands remain distinct from client requirements
The unresolved retention decision is an exclusion and coding-agent stop condition
prohibitions: Do not modify production or test files
Do not invent requirements, examples, retention values, interfaces, or architecture
Do not claim that packaged verification commands passed
